thesis: Buying a small-cap, still-loss-making medtech into a 0.95-confidence risk-off tape (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX 31.34 at the 99th percentile) is poor timing. The stock is up about 62% in 126 days and has already faded 8% from its post-earnings high, so the earnings re-rating looks to be unwinding with no fresh catalyst. The 25.92 target is a prior supply zone, and a market-wide liquidation can gap a thin name (average volume about 0.7M) through the 22.55 stop. Insider selling by the CEO and two officers right after the pop adds to the caution. Sequential revenue slipped and the stock trades at 4.85x sales with negative forward earnings.
